meta.subtitle: Concrete commit-by-commit phasing to ship every Tier 1-3 type from the visualization roadmap.
meta.summary: Eighteen new viz types, each as its own commit. Each commit lands: schema delta + renderer + reference entry + regression test + browser bounding-box check. Total estimated work: 5-8 focused days. Order: Tier 2 (Mermaid, doc-only) first → Tier 1 (8 in-house SVG, ship-next) → Tier 3 (deferred reopens).

blocks.summary: Eighteen viz types pending across three tiers. Each commits as a self-contained unit. Mermaid unlock (Tier 2) is doc-only and ships first. The eight Tier 1 in-house SVG types follow in priority order. Tier 3 stays deferred but each has its concrete spec.
bullets: Phase 0 — Tier 2 Mermaid (1 day): docs/reference.json examples for ER, state, class, mindmap, timeline, gitgraph; mark Mermaid as ‘fully supported’.
Phase 1 — Tier 1 SVG, group A (2-3 days): heatmap, histogram, sparkline, waffle. Smallest renderers, highest reader value.
Phase 2 — Tier 1 SVG, group B (2-3 days): calendar-heatmap, gauge, radar, treemap. Mid-complexity.
Phase 3 — Tier 3 active picks (1-2 days each): box-plot, bullet, slope. Ship when a doc page asks.
Phase 4 — Tier 3 heavies (3+ days each): graph (force-directed) + sankey. Lazy-load d3-force / d3-sankey.
Phase 5 — Mermaid interactivity polish: pan/zoom on diagram lightbox, fullscreen, copy-as-image.

blocks.title: Cross-cutting floor (applies to every new viz)
blocks.lead: Carry this checklist into every commit. Each line is testable.

items: **Schema:** new `type` enum value on `chart`, plus the new fields, with `additionalProperties: false`. Round-trip validates against `kit/schema/page.schema.json`.
**Renderer:** new `_renderX` branch on the `html-doc-chart` Custom Element. Lazy: only the active type's renderer runs.
**Theme tokens:** every fill/stroke pulls from CSS variables; no hardcoded hex. Recompute on `html-doc:theme-changed`.
**ViewBox-responsive:** scales down to 360 px width without overflow.
**Toolbar:** copy-data (CSV) + screenshot (PNG) + lightbox-expand. Reuses `hdt-bar` chrome.

**Data-table fallback:** `
Show data…
` rendered after the SVG for screen-readers + keyboard.
**Aria label:** `role="img"` + one-sentence summary.
**Reference entry:** code-sample + live render added to `docs/reference.json`.
**Regression test:** content-regression that the type validates + rejects misshaped.
**Browser assertion:** Playwright bounding-box check at desktop AND 360 px (deferred until Playwright surface exists).
**Skill rule:** `uv run oku check` passes after every JSON edit (already in SKILL.md).

blocks.title: Phase 0 — Tier 2 Mermaid unlock (doc-only)
blocks.lead: Zero renderer code. Author six reference examples; the existing diagram primitive renders them.

rows: ER, state, class, mindmap, timeline, gitgraph — each a heading + live `diagram` block (already done in docs/plans/visualizations.json's Tier 2)
`diagram.source` description names the supported first-line triggers
How to pick between flowchart / ER / state / class / mindmap / timeline / gitgraph

blocks.title: Phase 1 — Tier 1 SVG, group A
blocks.lead: Smallest renderers, highest reader value. ~2-3 commits.

items: Schema: `{ type: "heatmap", rows: [String], cols: [String], values: [[Number]], scale: "sequential"|"diverging", domain?: [min,max], palette?: "accent"|"viridis"|"cividis" }`.
Renderer: ~150 LoC. SVG `<rect>` grid + token-derived palette function.
Numeric assertion: rect count == rows.length × cols.length.
Reference sample: 5×5 correlation matrix with diverging palette.
Schema: `{ type: "histogram", bins?: [{lo,hi,count}], values?: [Number], binCount?: 20, density?: Bool }`.
Renderer: ~100 LoC. Reuses the Cartesian SVG plot (axes, pan, zoom).
Numeric assertion: bar count == bins.length (or binCount if from raw values).
Reference sample: 20-bin latency distribution.
Schema: `{ type: "sparkline", values: [Number], variant: "line"|"area"|"bar", showEndpoint?: Bool, endLabel?: String }`.
Renderer: ~60 LoC. No axes, sized by parent font metrics.
Numeric assertion: SVG height ≈ 1.2× line-height.
Reference sample: inline next to a KPI tile + inside a table cell.
Schema: `{ type: "waffle", total?: 100, rows?: 10, cols?: 10, segments: [{label,count,color?}] }`.
Renderer: ~70 LoC. Flex grid of `<rect>`s + legend.
Numeric assertion: filled cells == sum(segments.count).
Reference sample: user-status breakdown (active/trial/paused/churned).
Schema: `{ type: "calendar-heatmap", year?: Number, values: { ISO_DATE: Number }, scale?, domain? }`.
Renderer: ~180 LoC. Date math + reuse heatmap palette.
Numeric assertion: cell count == days-in-year for the active year.
Reference sample: 2026 activity calendar.
Schema: `{ type: "gauge", value, min?: 0, max, target?, label?, zones?: [{from,to,tone}] }`.
Renderer: ~120 LoC. SVG arc paths.
Numeric assertion: needle angle = (value-min)/(max-min) × π.
Reference sample: SLO budget (92% with target 80%).
Schema: `{ type: "radar", axes: [{label,max?}], series: [{name,values:[Number]}], scale: "shared"|"per-axis" }`.
Renderer: ~150 LoC. Polygon points via centre + r·cos/sin.
Numeric assertion: polygon vertex count == axes.length per series.
Reference sample: tool comparison across 5 criteria.
Schema (flat first): `{ type: "treemap", items: [{label,value,color?}] }`. Add `children: [...]` in a follow-up.
Renderer: ~200 LoC. Squarified treemap layout (no dep).
Numeric assertion: sum(rect area) == container area (within 1px rounding).
Reference sample: LoC by language.

blocks.title: Phase 3 — Tier 3 active picks
blocks.lead: Each ships when a real doc page asks. Specs ready so the reopen is fast.

blocks.title: Phase 4 — Heavies
blocks.lead: Each is its own multi-day commit. Lazy-load the underlying engine.

items: Schema: `{ kind: "graph", nodes: [{id,label,group?}], edges: [{from,to,weight?,label?}], layout?: "force"|"layered" }`.
Engine: `d3-force` lazy-loaded from CDN. Falls back to static layered SVG if offline.
Numeric assertion: node count + edge count == input counts; final positions stable after simulation tick budget.
Reopen trigger: 5+ node mesh visualization needed in a real doc page.
Ship Mermaid's `sankey-beta` first; build in-house only if the beta fails.
Schema: `{ type: "sankey", nodes: [{id,label}], links: [{source,target,value}] }`.
Engine: `d3-sankey` lazy-load OR hand-rolled left-to-right (~300 LoC).
Numeric assertion: band width ∝ link value; sum(in) == sum(out) per node (modulo source/sink terminals).
Reopen trigger: Mermaid sankey-beta breaks on a real page (label overlap, non-bipartite).

blocks.title: Phase 5 — Mermaid interactivity polish
blocks.lead: Diagrams already render well. Make them inspect-able.

items: **Pan + zoom on lightbox-expanded diagrams.** Re-use the chart's panZoom hook on the cloned SVG when opened in lightbox.
**Click-a-node-to-highlight.** Mermaid emits class names per node; attach a click handler that toggles `data-hdt-focused` on the clicked node + dims siblings.
**Copy as PNG** (already exists for charts) — also for diagrams. Same `__htmldocVisualTools.svgToPng` flow.
**Persistent fullscreen URL** — `#diagram-id:fullscreen` opens the diagram in lightbox on page load (deeplink-able).

blocks.title: What each commit looks like
blocks.lead: Use this as the template for every viz commit so the user can ship one per session reliably.

blocks.source:
feat(chart): <type> — <one-line description>

  Schema:
  - kit/schema/page.schema.json: add `type="<type>"` branch +
    required + additionalProperties:false.

  Renderer:
  - kit/chrome.js: _render<Type> in html-doc-chart; theme tokens for
    fill / stroke; lazy-attached toolbar.

  Reference:
  - docs/reference.json: code sample + live render under #charts/<type>.

  Tests:
  - src/html_doc_tests/test_content_regression.py:
    * accepts <type> with valid payload
    * rejects <type> with missing required fields
  - oku check --strict passes

  Verification record:
  - bounding-box at 1280: SVG dims ≈ <expected>
  - bounding-box at 360:  SVG dims ≈ <expected>

rows: Real KPI-tile demand for inline sparkline.
